description: Source code for an HTML report generator and server for test results in Playwright, including classes for report building, server setup, and utilities for handling test data and attachments.

classes.name: HtmlReporter
classes.description: Main class implementing test report generation, configuration, and server hosting for Playwright.

classes.name: HtmlBuilder
classes.description: Builds the HTML report, manages report data, and handles file operations.

classes.name: Base64Encoder
classes.description: Stream transformer encoding data to base64 for embedding in HTML.

methods.name: reportFolderFromEnv
methods.description: Resolves report folder path from environment variables.

methods.name: getHtmlReportOptionProcessEnv
methods.description: Gets HTML report open option from environment variables.

methods.name: showHTMLReport
methods.description: Starts a server and opens the HTML report in a browser.

methods.name: startHtmlReportServer
methods.description: Creates an HTTP server to serve report files.
